title: Kilkis — the beginning of the journey
fact: Goce Delčev was born on 4 February 1872 in Kilkis.
objective: Explore the birthplace and collect knowledge scrolls.

title: School and the love of learning
fact: Even as a child Goce read a lot; he spent his first school years in his native Kilkis.

title: Thessaloniki — a city of ideas
fact: Goce continued his education at a high school in Thessaloniki, a big city on the Aegean coast.
objective: Follow the lanterns through the city.

title: A cultural contest
fact: “I understand the world only as a field of cultural competition among nations.” — words of Goce Delčev.

title: Hard work and persistence
fact: In 1891 Goce went to study at a military school in Sofia.
objective: Persevere to the end of the path.

title: The teacher's mission
fact: In 1894 Goce became a teacher in Novo Selo near Štip.
objective: Bring the books to the classroom.

title: Štip — meeting Dame
fact: In Štip Goce met Dame Gruev and joined the Organization.

title: Inner strength
fact: The Organization was founded on 23 October 1893 in Thessaloniki.

title: Dame Gruev — comradeship and trust
fact: Dame Gruev, born in Smilevo, was one of the founders of the Organization.

title: A network of trust
fact: The Organization had its own committees in many towns and villages across Macedonia.
objective: Connect the committees and avoid obstacles.

title: Roads and channels
fact: Couriers and secret channels carried the letters and news between the committees.

title: Bansko and Pirin
fact: In the 1895/96 school year Goce was a teacher in Bansko, in the Pirin region.

title: Talking with the people
fact: Goce travelled a lot through the villages, talking with people about freedom and education.

title: Women in the cause
fact: Women too took part in the Organization — as teachers, couriers and helpers.
objective: Collect scrolls commemorating the brave women.

title: Jane Sandanski — mountain strategy
fact: Jane Sandanski was a vojvoda and a leader of the Organization in the Serres region.

title: Gjorce Petrov — the wisdom of words
fact: Gjorce Petrov and Goce together prepared the Statute of the Organization in 1896.

title: Pere Tošev — patience and order
fact: Pere Tošev, born in Prilep, was a teacher and one of the leaders of the Organization.

title: The people's school
fact: Many of the Organization's leaders were teachers, like Goce himself.

title: Freedom as responsibility
fact: From 1896 Goce and Gjorce Petrov were the Organization's representatives in Sofia.

title: The Thessaloniki Congress
fact: In 1896 a congress was held in Thessaloniki where the rules of the Organization were agreed.

title: The mountain path
fact: Goce walked through the whole of Macedonia, visiting the Organization's committees.

title: Night of lanterns
fact: To stay safe, the couriers and travellers of the Organization often travelled at night.

title: The courier's mission
fact: The Organization used ciphers — secret writing that only collaborators could read.

title: Council of comrades
fact: Goce, Dame, Gjorce, Pere and Jane were collaborators and comrades in the same struggle.

title: A map of ideals
fact: Goce wanted Macedonia to be free and all its people to live as equals.

title: Work and persistence II
fact: Goce was against an uprising too soon — he believed the people must first prepare well.

title: Dignity
fact: At the Thessaloniki Congress in January 1903 it was decided to raise an uprising.
objective: Keep your dignity throughout the path.

title: A bridge to the future
fact: In early 1903 Goce set out on a tour of Macedonia to meet the committees.
objective: Set off on the final journey.

title: The parents
fact: Goce's father was named Nikola, and his mother Sultana.
objective: Find the family names among the scrolls.

title: The teacher's voice
fact: Goce wrote many letters to his friends and collaborators; many of them are preserved to this day.

title: A lantern of nations
fact: The later statute of the Organization said any resident could be a member, regardless of ethnicity or faith.

title: The Serres region
fact: In the spring of 1903 Goce was in the Serres region, in the village of Banitsa.
objective: Reach the village by the mountains.

title: The road to Banitsa
fact: Goce Delčev died on 4 May 1903 near the village of Banitsa, in a fight with the Ottoman army.
objective: Pay respectful tribute to the historical figure.

title: Light over Macedonia
fact: On Ilinden, 2 August 1903, the Ilinden Uprising began.

title: The Kruševo Republic
fact: In Kruševo the Kruševo Republic was proclaimed; it lasted ten days.

title: Final mission — St. Spas
fact: Since 1946 the remains of Goce rest in the yard of the "St. Spas" church in Skopje.

title: Pantheon of wisdom
fact: The town of Delčevo and the "Goce Delčev" University in Štip carry his name.
